'''Mount Merakan''' was the tallest mountain on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Maramere]], on the world's largest island. Prior to the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] established a base of operations within the mountain.
